name: Antitrust and Competition
criteria: changes merger review, competition policy, or antitrust enforcement priorities at the FTC, DOJ or state attorneys general, directs cartel or price-fixing investigations, or targets market concentration in a named sector.

name: Appellate
criteria: alters a standard of judicial review, strips or confers jurisdiction, or creates a legal question squarely headed for the courts of appeals or the Supreme Court.

name: Bankruptcy and Restructuring
criteria: affects insolvency proceedings, creditor priority, distressed industries, or federally backed restructuring and bailout mechanisms.

name: Commercial Finance
criteria: changes lending, credit availability, secured transactions, or banking regulation in ways that reach loan terms or borrower obligations.

name: Corporate
criteria: affects corporate governance, securities disclosure, M&A clearance, foreign investment review, or the formation and registration of business entities.

name: Entertainment, Technology and Advertising
criteria: regulates media, online platforms, content moderation, advertising practices, artificial intelligence products, or telecommunications services.

name: Global Reach
criteria: imposes tariffs, sanctions, export controls, or investment restrictions, or otherwise governs cross-border trade and the conduct of U.S. parties abroad.

name: Governmental
criteria: sets conditions on federal contracts, grants, or funding, restructures an agency, or changes procurement, lobbying, or administrative procedure.

subPractices.name: Congressional Investigations
subPractices.criteria: congressional subpoenas, hearings, testimony, document demands, or legislative oversight directed at private parties or agencies.

subPractices.name: Government Contracts
subPractices.criteria: federal procurement, contractor compliance obligations, bid protests, contract disputes, or suspension and debarment.

subPractices.name: Healthcare Regulatory
subPractices.criteria: HHS, CMS or OIG regulation — reimbursement, coverage, fraud and abuse, provider compliance, or healthcare False Claims Act enforcement.

subPractices.name: International Trade
subPractices.criteria: compliance with and enforcement of trade regulation — export controls, sanctions screening, customs classification, or foreign investment review such as CFIUS. Use the standalone Global Reach area instead when the order simply imposes tariffs, sanctions or trade restrictions; this subgroup is for the regulatory obligations they create.

subPractices.name: Life Sciences / FDA
subPractices.criteria: FDA regulation of drugs, biologics or medical devices — approvals, labeling, marketing practices, clinical trials, manufacturing standards, or safety enforcement.

subPractices.name: National Security
subPractices.criteria: defense, intelligence, classified information, security clearances, critical infrastructure, or cybersecurity and AI addressed in a national-security frame.

subPractices.name: Public Policy and Government Affairs
subPractices.criteria: the structure and machinery of government itself — creating, reorganizing or directing agencies, rulemaking and administrative procedure, federal workforce policy, lobbying, or intergovernmental relations.

name: Intellectual Property
criteria: affects patents, trademarks, copyright, trade secrets, licensing, or federal technology-transfer and research-commercialization rules.

name: Labor and Employment
criteria: changes hiring, wages, workplace rules, workforce eligibility, employment-based immigration, collective bargaining, or terms for federal employees and contractor workforces.

name: Land Use
criteria: affects zoning, siting, permitting, environmental review of development, or the approval path for building on federal or private land.

name: Litigation
criteria: creates or removes a private right of action, alters litigation procedure, evidence, remedies, or access to court, or directs enforcement or investigation against specifically identified parties. Do not select this merely because the order is controversial or may attract a legal challenge — nearly every executive order may.

name: Privacy and Cybersecurity
criteria: sets data protection, cybersecurity, surveillance, or breach-reporting obligations, or governs the handling of personal or classified information.

name: Private Client Services
criteria: affects individual income, gift, or estate taxation, wealth transfer, or the immigration status and travel of individuals rather than businesses.

name: Private Equity
criteria: restricts or conditions fund investment, limits foreign capital, or changes the regulatory exposure of portfolio companies and deal approvals.

name: Private Wealth and Fiduciary Litigation
criteria: affects trusts, estates, fiduciary duties, or disputes over the administration of private wealth.

name: Real Estate
criteria: affects property acquisition, leasing, development, housing policy, or the disposition and use of federal real property.

name: Tax
criteria: changes tax rates, credits, deductions, tax-exempt status, or IRS administration and enforcement. Tariffs and import duties are Global Reach, not Tax, unless the order also changes tax-code treatment.

name: White Collar Defense and Investigations
criteria: directs criminal or civil enforcement, investigations, prosecutions, debarment, or the suspension of security clearances — including DOJ, SEC or CFPB enforcement, FCPA, the False Claims Act, fraud, or securities enforcement.
